paite: Kuapeuh Jesu, Khrist ahi chih gingta Pathian suahsak ahi; kuapeuh asuaksakpa it in asuahsak leng a-it nak hi.
heading: Khovel Tung A Vualzohna

paite: Hiai ah Pathian tate i itna ah Pathian i it a, athupiakte i zui chih i thei uhi.
Pathian i itna hiai ahi, athupiakte i zuihna; athupiakte lah ahaksa ngal kei hi.
Pathian suahsak peuh in khovel azou zel hi; hiai ahi khovel tung a vualzohna, i ginna uh.
Jesu, Pathian Tapa ahi chih gingtami kia ngal lou, kua'n khovel azou zel a?
Hiai ahi tui leh sisan a hong paipa, Jesu Khrist; tui kia ah hilou in, tui ah leh sisan ah ahi zaw. Theisakpa tuh Kha ahi, Kha thutak ahih ziak in.
heading: Jesu Khrist Theihpihna

paite: Van tung ah theihpih thum a-om, Pa, Thu leh Kha Siangthou ahi ua, amaute khat ahi uhi.
Leitung ah theihpih thum a-om, Kha leh tui leh sisan; huai thumte akithutuak uhi.
Mihing theihpihna bawn i sanleh Pathian theihpihna athupizaw hi. Pathian theihpihna tuh a Tapa tanchin atheipihta chih ahi.
Pathian Tapa gingtami in amah ah theihna anei a, Pathian gingtaloumi in amah zuauthei in abawl hi; Pathian in a Tapa tanchin atheihpih agintak louh ziak in.
Theihpihna hiai ahi, Pathian in tangtawn hinna ahon pia a, huai hinna a Tapa ah a-om hi.
Kuapeuh Tapa nei in hinna anei; kuapeuh Pathian Tapa nei lou in hinna anei kei hi.
Tangtawn hinna na nei uh chih na theihna ding un, nou Pathian Tapa min gingtate kiang ah hiai thu ka gelh ahi.
heading: Tangtawn Hinna

paite: Hiai pen amah tung a i hangsanna ahi, bangpeuh ama deihlam bang a i ngetleh ama'n ahon ngaihkhiaksak hi.
Huchi in bangpeuh i nget ahon ngaihkhiaksak chih i theihleh akiang a i thilnget i muta chih i thei hi.

Kuapeuh in a-unau sihna khop hilou khelhna hih in muleh angetsak ding, huchi in Pathian in an genmi kiang ah sihna tun hilou khelhna hihte a ding in hinna ape ding hi. Sihna tun khelhna a-om a; huchibang lam ah angetsak ding ka chi ahi kei hi.
Diktatlouhna tengteng khelhna ahi; sihna khop hilou khelhna leng a-om sam hi.
Kuapeuh Pathian suahsak in thil ahihkhial kei chih i thei hi; Pathian Tapa neihsun in amah akem gige a, giloupa'n khoih leng akhoih thei kei hi.
Huan eite Pathian a kipan i hi chih i thei ua, khovel pumpi bel giloupa thuthu in a-om chih i thei hi.

Huan Pathian Tapa ahong pai a, adikpa i theihna ding in theihtheihna ahon pia chih i thei behlap uhi; eite a Tapa Jesu Khrist a i om in adikpa ah i om uhi. Amah tuh Pathian diktak leh tangtawn hinna ahi.
Naute aw, milim lak ah kihemkhia un, Amen.
